svg.title: INTERSECTIONS / Grid map
svg.desc: A 16-column, 8-row Grid with square pads on an equal horizontal and vertical pitch. Colors identify control groups, not physical LED colors. Coordinates are column then row; bottom-right 16,8 is the navigation modifier.

g.text: T1–T8: one row per track. Harmonic and rhythmic actions combine.
M mute / RT retrigger / REV reverse
RS reset self / RO reset others / RA reset all
LFO: tap master on/off / hold all-target freeze
V: hold to preview this track on norns
NAV: hold; blank cols. 6, 13, and 16 above it
